annotations.title: Switch an Automatic Store Message On/Off

description: Turn ONE automatic store message on or off — an order/store notification, an abandoned-cart reminder or an automation reminder — exactly like its toggle in the LetsBot panel. Get kind + id from list_store_automations first. Turning it ON makes LetsBot message the merchant's customers automatically every time the event happens (Meta bills each message on an official WhatsApp number), so only do it when the merchant explicitly asks, and it needs confirm=true after showing the preview. Turning it OFF takes effect immediately and needs no confirmation. It does NOT edit the message text, submit templates to Meta, send a test, or create/delete automations (those are done in the LetsBot panel). Older per-store reminders (legacy_cart_reminder) cannot be switched here.

active.description: true = switch ON (starts automatic sends), false = switch OFF.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to switch the automation on. Only checked when active=true; when switching OFF any value is accepted.

id.description: The automation id, as returned by list_store_automations (ids are per kind).

kind.description: The automation kind, as returned by list_store_automations.

name: set_store_automation_active
